\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{স্মৃতিস্তম্ভ} (smritistômbhô)}{স্মৃতিস্তম্ভ (smritistômbhô)}]{\bn{স্মৃতিস্তম্ভ} (smritistômbhô) — a memorial; a monument}

\label{lesson:BN-C320-smritistombho}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for an inscription, then the Bengali for currency.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{স্মৃতিস্তম্ভ}}
\textbf{\bn{স্মৃতিস্তম্ভ}} — \emph{smritistômbhô} — \textquotedblleft{}a memorial; a monument\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{নদীর} \bn{পাশে} \bn{শহিদদের} \bn{একটা} \bn{স্মৃতিস্তম্ভ} \bn{আছে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nôdīr pāshe shôhidder ekṭā smritistômbhô āchhe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Beside the river there is a memorial to the martyrs.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{স্মৃতিস্তম্ভ}} (\emph{smritistômbhô}) joins \textbf{\bn{স্মৃতি}}, memory, to Sanskrit \emph{stambha}, 'a post, a pillar' (Monier-Williams): a pillar of memory.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{smritistômbhô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{smritistômbhô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nôdīr pāshe shôhidder ekṭā smritistômbhô āchhe.} — Beside the river there is a memorial to the martyrs.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for an inscription, then the Bengali for currency, then say \emph{smritistômbhô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{স্মৃতিস্তম্ভ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A memorial; a monument\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{নির্মাণ} \bn{করা} (nirmān kôrā)}{নির্মাণ করা (nirmān kôrā)}]{\bn{নির্মাণ} \bn{করা} (nirmān kôrā) — to construct}

\label{lesson:BN-C320-nirman-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for currency, then the Bengali for a memorial.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{নির্মাণ} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{নির্মাণ} \bn{করা}} — \emph{nirmān kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to construct\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{সম্রাট} \bn{নদীর} \bn{ওপর} \bn{একটা} \bn{পাথরের} \bn{সেতু} \bn{নির্মাণ} \bn{করলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sômrāṭ nôdīr opôr ekṭā pāthôrer setu nirmān kôrlen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The emperor built a stone bridge over the river.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{একটা} \bn{মন্দির} \bn{নির্মাণ} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini ekṭā mondir nirmān kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{নির্মাণ} \bn{করা}} (\emph{nirmān kôrā}) puts Sanskrit \emph{nirmāṇa}, 'measuring; making, building' (Monier-Williams), before \bn{করা}. It is the formal word; \textbf{\bn{গড়া}} is the everyday one.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nirmān kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nirmān kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sômrāṭ nôdīr opôr ekṭā pāthôrer setu nirmān kôrlen.} — The emperor built a stone bridge over the river.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for currency, then the Bengali for a memorial, then say \emph{nirmān kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{নির্মাণ} \bn{করা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To construct\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সমাধি} (sômādhi)}{সমাধি (sômādhi)}]{\bn{সমাধি} (sômādhi) — a tomb}

\label{lesson:BN-C320-somadhi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a memorial, then the Bengali for to construct.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সমাধি}}
\textbf{\bn{সমাধি}} — \emph{sômādhi} — \textquotedblleft{}a tomb\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{পাহাড়ের} \bn{ওপরে} \bn{এক} \bn{বীরের} \bn{সমাধি} \bn{আছে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pāhāṛer opôre ek bīrer sômādhi āchhe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
On top of the hill is the tomb of a hero.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সমাধি}} (\emph{sômādhi}) is Sanskrit \emph{samādhi}, 'a putting together' and the deep stillness of meditation (Monier-Williams), which also records it as the shrine or tomb of a saint; Bengali uses it for any tomb.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sômādhi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sômādhi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pāhāṛer opôre ek bīrer sômādhi āchhe.} — On top of the hill is the tomb of a hero.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a memorial, then the Bengali for to construct, then say \emph{sômādhi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{সমাধি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A tomb\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{গম্বুজ} (gômbuj)}{গম্বুজ (gômbuj)}]{\bn{গম্বুজ} (gômbuj) — a dome}

\label{lesson:BN-C320-gombuj}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to construct, then the Bengali for a tomb.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{গম্বুজ}}
\textbf{\bn{গম্বুজ}} — \emph{gômbuj} — \textquotedblleft{}a dome\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{পর্যটকরা} \bn{মসজিদের} \bn{বড়} \bn{গম্বুজের} \bn{ছবি} \bn{তুললেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pôrjôṭôkrā mosjider bôṛo gômbujer chhôbi tullen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The tourists took pictures of the mosque's great dome.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{গম্বুজ}} (\emph{gômbuj}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{gumbaz}, 'a dome', a word that came with the domed mosques and tombs of Bengal.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gômbuj}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gômbuj}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pôrjôṭôkrā mosjider bôṛo gômbujer chhôbi tullen.} — The tourists took pictures of the mosque's great dome.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to construct, then the Bengali for a tomb, then say \emph{gômbuj} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{গম্বুজ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A dome\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{স্থাপত্য} (sthāpôtyô)}{স্থাপত্য (sthāpôtyô)}]{\bn{স্থাপত্য} (sthāpôtyô) — architecture}

\label{lesson:BN-C320-sthapotyo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a tomb, then the Bengali for a dome.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{স্থাপত্য}}
\textbf{\bn{স্থাপত্য}} — \emph{sthāpôtyô} — \textquotedblleft{}architecture\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{দুর্গের} \bn{স্থাপত্য} \bn{দেখতে} \bn{অনেক} \bn{পর্যটক} \bn{আসেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{durger sthāpôtyô dekhte ônek pôrjôṭôk āsen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Many tourists come to see the architecture of the fort.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{স্থাপত্য}} (\emph{sthāpôtyô}) is Sanskrit \emph{sthāpatya}, which Monier-Williams gives as 'architecture, building' and derives from \emph{sthapati}, a master builder: the master builder's art.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sthāpôtyô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sthāpôtyô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{durger sthāpôtyô dekhte ônek pôrjôṭôk āsen.} — Many tourists come to see the architecture of the fort.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a tomb, then the Bengali for a dome, then say \emph{sthāpôtyô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{স্থাপত্য} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Architecture\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
